webster.text: Lessened in value or price; undervalued.

example.quote: it, at a depreciated value, in orders, tender laws have been passed, obliging the creditor to receive on execution other property than money in discharge of his demand, and in several of the states laws have been made unfavorable to the creditor and tending to render property insecure.
example.cite: Brutus XIV, New York Journal, Feb. 28, 1788
